author: peterbailey-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the enhancement

t2_single_node_min_first_6ports not included as a qos topology
needed for q3d

### Current Behavior

missing t2_single_node_min_first_6ports

### Proposed Behavior

add t2_single_node_min_first_6ports
